findings.summary: minimumVersion only accepts a bare `>=X.Y.Z` range, so a later change to a compound range such as `>=22.12.0 <25` would fail this test even though the floor still holds. This looks intentional (it fails safe). A short comment saying the strict format is deliberate would stop a later maintainer from loosening the check without thinking about it.
